details:
Was in a instance with multiple users and using custom emoji I got booted out of the instance.

Log gives this message "[Behaviour] Received executive message: The VRChat Anti-Cheat system has failed too many times for you lately. Please wait and try again later. If that does not work, check status.vrchat.com for server issues. You can also try verifying your installation and / or completely reinstall VRChat. If the issue persists, contact our Support team at vrch.at/support"

This also happend to a friend of mine in the same instance around the same time that was also using several custom emoji.

As far I know other users were not affected.

The instance is then no longer accessible.

Went to a different instance, and after using custom emoji it happend again. 

Deleted vrchat, followed these steps https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500002247921-VRChat-keeps-crashing-or-has-issues-launching-properly Reinstalled VRChat and now testing again. 

---test update--- After following the above steps I have not noticed this behavior again.

In the beta channel on discord more people were mentioning they noticed this behavior.

Wondering if more users have this issue, or if this is a temporary thing.
title: EAC triggers when using custom emoji
